comment: A specific offering of a study program during a semester at a campus -- the thing courses actually get scheduled into.

columns.name: study_program_id
columns.comment: Study program this term is an offering of.

columns.name: semester_id
columns.comment: Semester this term runs in. Unique together with campus_id and study_program_id: a study program can't have two terms in the same semester at the same campus.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Surrogate identifier for the term, auto-generated by the database and unique across the whole system.
